In a situation where I noticed team ownership and performance issues due to conflicting leadership approaches, I took several steps to address the challenges.

Facilitating Open Communication
I organized a team meeting to create a safe space for dialogue. I encouraged team members to express their concerns about the leadership styles they were experiencing. This open forum allowed everyone to share their perspectives and fostered a sense of trust.

Identifying Common Goals
During the meeting, we collaboratively identified our key objectives. I facilitated discussions around what success looked like for the team and helped everyone articulate their individual contributions to these goals. This process helped align our focus and reduce confusion stemming from differing leadership approaches.

Developing Shared Understanding
To ensure everyone was on the same page, we created a team charter that outlined our roles, responsibilities, and expectations. We also established clear communication protocols to address any future conflicts quickly. By involving the team in this process, I empowered them to take ownership of their roles and fostered a collective commitment to our shared goals.

Handling the Situation
I scheduled regular follow-up meetings to monitor progress and address any emerging issues. By maintaining open lines of communication and encouraging ongoing feedback, I was able to create a collaborative environment that improved team cohesion and performance. Over time, we saw enhanced ownership and a more unified approach to leadership within the team.
